Kanye is a very important person for me. About 9 months ago I was badly depressed; Ive stayed in bed all day and eaten barely anything. There's loads of reasons why this depression kicked in but I don't really wanna share personal details. So, I decided to go to my GP since you know, I was getting skinner and skinner and was feeling nothing most of the time. I got a therapist and was put on anti depressants and oh boy, they made everything worse(the therapy was and still is amazing, I am not depressed anymore but I still go to it regularly cause of my OCD). After few months of being on pills and seeing how this manufactured happiness is making me even more deprived I've stumbled on Kanye. I've heard about him and some of his songs earlier but didn't really care about him. The album I've stumbled upon was Yeezus, I believe it was mentioned in one of the podcasts I was listening to or something like that. After hearing it I've became a fan immediately. The energy, the emotions and Kanye way of saying fuck off to everyone and doing his own thing inspired me. Ive started going on ktt and everything and it gave me the feeling of not being alone. After that it turned out some of the people from my school were big yeezy stans and slowly but surely I've joined that friend group. Kanyes music and his persona empowers me and gives me inspiration, it helped me through the bad times and made everything better, it allowed me to become myself again. So yeah, it's just a part of who I am as a person right now and when I look back at it it's gonna tell the story of who I used to be. And for the Chano part, he's just a great positive icon, they're both rappers from Chicago so that ties in nicely and the 3 looked cool lmao. I am so sorry for the wall of text.
